evidence.label: Growth with product gap
evidence.caption: This account is growing fast in related products but does not buy a complementary one. That gap is a sales opportunity.
evidence.definition: Order volume growth for an account in >=2 therapy areas while a complementary therapy area has near-zero purchase.
evidence.note: Growing in ckd mbd, renal anemia; no renal-nutrition purchases in 12 weeks
